# FDGA025

> DO add a blank line after a closing brace, unless the next line is also a closing brace.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.4 Vertical Whitespace.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE2003
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

IDE2003 reports statements that follow a block, not members that follow a member.

## Options

```ini
dotnet_style_allow_statement_immediately_after_block_experimental = false
```
